scope: Engineering equivalence and move latency with a serial exact WASM sparse accumulator; no new learning or pretrained chess policy
order: Alternate oracle/candidate and candidate/oracle within each fixture
adoption: Only after the live 50-game invocation is terminal, exact equivalence and matched timing pass, full npm test passes, and browser HTTP move application is verified. Otherwise preserve failed evidence and do not adopt.
limits: Four pairs per fixture on one host; report raw samples, median/p95/max, CPU and elapsed time. No larger-workload or time-to-useful-learning claim. Fixtures are historical development engineering positions, never final transfer families. Cold load and comparison overhead are separate from timed moves.
backend: WebAssembly 1.0 opcodes, f32/f64 loads and separate f64 mul/add; no SIMD, threads, fast-math or new dependency
